body:
This issue needs clarification before autonomous execution:

1. This ticket declares hard dependencies on #49, #50, and #51 — all three have open PRs (#55, #56, #57) that have not merged to main yet. The lifecycle files being modified here need to reference the `github-issues` and `linear-issues` behaviors and read from `config.yaml`, none of which exist on main. Should this ticket wait until all three dependencies merge, or should work begin on a branch that stacks on top of the dependency branches?

This issue is labeled autonomously-nightly but cannot proceed without answers to the above.
Once resolved, re-run the nightly workflow or remove the label and work on it manually.
